root_cause: CachingTest's LoadMultiWithConfig_race / LoadMulti_race test family spins up multiple threads racing to compile/import the same cached model concurrently on a MockPlugin, and asserts a fixed expected call count for import_model(). On Windows runners the thread-scheduling timing is not fully deterministic, so occasionally one of the racing threads loses the race before its import_model() call is dispatched, leading to an observed call count one short of the expected value. This is a pre-existing flaky test unrelated to the PR's LPT (MultiplyPartialTransformation) changes - the PR only touches src/common/low_precision_transformations, which CachingTest does not exercise. This exact failure signature has recurred 10 times since 2026-07-13 across many unrelated PRs, confirming it is a known timing-dependent flaky test rather than a regression caused by this change.
reproduction_steps: Run `ov_inference_functional_tests --gtest_filter=CachingTest/CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race*` repeatedly (ideally in a loop, e.g. --gtest_repeat=50) on a Windows runner/VM under load; the race is timing-dependent and may not reproduce on a single run or on a lightly-loaded local machine.
recommended_actions: Re-run only the failed job (safe since the failure is a flaky test unrelated to the PR changes); no code change is required for this PR.

File/track a dedicated flakiness ticket for src/inference/tests/functional/caching_test.cpp CachingTest.*_race tests to either loosen the EXPECT_CALL cardinality (e.g. AtLeast/AtMost or a retry-tolerant assertion) or add explicit synchronization so the race condition does not affect the assertion.
Mark the CachingTest.*_race parametrized cases as known-flaky (e.g., via a retry mechanism or gtest_repeat with failure tolerance) until the synchronization fix lands.
prevention_strategies: Avoid asserting an exact EXPECT_CALL count on inherently racy, multi-threaded test scenarios; either add explicit thread synchronization barriers before verifying mock expectations, or use a tolerant cardinality (e.g., Between(n-1, n)) to absorb benign scheduling variance on slower/busier Windows runners.
historical_context: This exact signature (hash 43e136cf67333978) has now recurred 10 times since 2026-07-13T10:41:15Z (most recently 2026-08-28T21:27:20Z before this run), across at least 9 different unrelated PRs (#36488, #36872, #37114, #37187, #36684, #37197, #37500, #37653). Closely related variants also exist for LoadMulti_race (hashes 5f5789b1a8659a47, 0528d54ff68248cd, 18324e8563a426a9) and a TearDown file-lock flake (1bf590cbb88911b2), all pointing at the same CachingTest Windows timing flakiness family.
